candidates.change_summary: Replace acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value) with acc.balance = acc.balance so the balance is not updated.
Insert msg.sender.call{value: msg.value}("") before updating balance so the payment is forwarded immediately without updating state.
Replace acc.unlockTime assignment with a constant value so the unlock time never updates.
Remove nonReentrant guard logic so reentrancy can change Put behavior.
Replace `require(!locked_); locked_ = true;` with `require(true);` to disable the lock, allowing reentrant calls to Collect and potentially changing the observed Collect balance after reentrancy.
Delete `locked_ = true;` so lock is never set, enabling reentrant calls that can alter the Collect balance observation.
Delete `locked_ = false;` so lock is never released after execution, permanently blocking future Collect calls and changing the observable outcome of Collect.

Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` with `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` causing balance to increase instead of decrease on Collect, directly changing the observable state after the call.
Delete `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` so balance is not reduced after sending funds, leaving the public Acc mapping unchanged for the user despite a successful transfer.

Replace `if( acc.balance>=MinSum && acc.balance>=_am && block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime)` condition with `if(true)` to allow Collect regardless of balance or unlock time, altering the conditions under which balance is decremented.
Replace `if (_s)` with `if (!_s)` so balance is decremented only when the external call fails, inverting the success logic and directly changing the post-call Acc balance.
